en: Did you receive the purchase order?
py: Cǎi gòu dìng dān shōu dào le ma?

en: Please use the price on the quote.
zh: 请按报价单上的价格做。
py: Qǐng àn bào jià dān shàng de jià gé zuò.

en: Does this unit price include tax?
py: Zhè ge dān jià hán shuì ma?

en: Can you move the delivery up by a week?
py: Jiāo qī néng tí qián yì zhōu ma?

en: Change the quantity to five hundred for now.
py: Shù liàng xiān gǎi chéng wǔ bǎi jiàn.

en: Please email the quote to me.
py: Qǐng bǎ bào jià fā dào wǒ yóu xiāng.

en: This quote is valid until the end of the month.
py: Zhè bǎn bào jià dào yuè dǐ yǒu xiào.

en: What is the minimum order quantity?
py: Qǐ dìng liàng shì duō shǎo?

en: Please confirm the order number.
py: Qǐng bāng wǒ què rèn dìng dān hào.

en: The customer hasn't approved this order yet.
zh: 客户还没批准这个订单。
py: Kè hù hái méi pī zhǔn zhè ge dìng dān.

en: Please issue a special VAT invoice.
py: Qǐng kāi zēng zhí shuì zhuān yòng fā piào.

en: Use the full company name on the invoice.
zh: 发票抬头请写公司全称。
py: Fā piào tái tóu qǐng xiě gōng sī quán chēng.

en: I sent the tax ID on WeChat.
py: Shuì hào wǒ fā nǐ wēi xìn le.

en: The amount on this invoice is wrong.
py: Zhè zhāng fā piào jīn é bú duì.

en: Send the invoice with the delivery note.
zh: 发票和送货单一起寄来。
py: Fā piào hé sòng huò dān yì qǐ jì lái.

en: This payment is due before the end of the month.
py: Zhè bǐ kuǎn yuè dǐ qián yào fù.

en: We paid thirty percent up front.
zh: 预付款付了百分之三十。
py: Yù fù kuǎn fù le bǎi fēn zhī sān shí.

en: We'll pay the balance after acceptance.
py: Wěi kuǎn děng yàn shōu hòu zài fù.

en: Please send me the statement.
py: Qǐng bǎ duì zhàng dān fā wǒ.

en: This invoice needs to be reissued.
py: Zhè zhāng fā piào xū yào chóng kāi.

en: The packing list has to match the invoice.
zh: 装箱单和发票数量要对上。
py: Zhuāng xiāng dān hé fā piào shù liàng yào duì shàng.

en: Please send me the packing list to check.
py: Qǐng bǎ zhuāng xiāng dān fā wǒ hé duì.

en: Are the shipping marks on the outer cartons?
py: Wài xiāng mài tóu tiē hǎo le ma?

en: Write both the gross weight and the net weight.
py: Máo zhòng hé jìng zhòng dōu yào xiě shàng.

en: Tell me when the bill of lading number is out.
py: Tí dān hào chū lái le gào sù wǒ.

en: Are the customs documents complete?
py: Bào guān zī liào qí le ma?

en: Post the shipping photos in the group.
py: Chū huò zhào piàn fā dào qún lǐ.

en: This shipment goes by sea.
py: Zhè piào huò zǒu hǎi yùn.

en: Let me write down the tracking number.
py: Kuài dì dān hào wǒ jì yí xià.

en: Please scan the delivery receipt and send it back.
py: Qiān shōu dān qǐng sǎo miáo huí chuán.

en: Who is writing the minutes today?
py: Jīn tiān shuí xiě huì yì jì yào?

en: I'll send the minutes to the group.
py: Wǒ bǎ jì yào fā dào qún lǐ.

en: Each action needs an owner and a date.
zh: 待办要写负责人和日期。
py: Dài bàn yào xiě fù zé rén hé rì qī.

en: Let's write this decision down.
py: Zhè ge jié lùn wǒ men jì xià lái.

en: Is last meeting's action done?
py: Shàng cì de dài bàn zuò wán le ma?

en: Please add your comments.
py: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de yì jiàn bǔ shàng.

en: Mark this point as not confirmed yet.
py: Zhè yì diǎn xiān biāo chéng dài què rèn.

en: I'll send the minutes before I leave today.
py: Jì yào wǒ xià bān qián fā chū qù.

en: If you have edits, change them in the document.
py: Yǒu xiū gǎi jiù zài wén dàng lǐ gǎi.

en: The next meeting is Thursday afternoon.
zh: 下次会议定在周四下午。
py: Xià cì huì yì dìng zài zhōu sì xià wǔ.

en: Please turn in leave requests by Friday.
zh: 请在周五前把请假交上来。
py: Qǐng zài zhōu wǔ qián bǎ qǐng jià jiāo shàng lái.

en: Fire drill tomorrow morning at nine.
zh: 明天上午九点消防演练。
py: Míng tiān shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn xiāo fáng yǎn liàn.

en: Lost your badge? Get a new one from admin.
zh: 工牌丢了，请去行政补办。
py: Gōng pái diū le, qǐng qù xíng zhèng bǔ bàn.

en: This month's payslip is in your email.
zh: 这个月工资条在邮箱里。
py: Zhè ge yuè gōng zī tiáo zài yóu xiāng lǐ.

en: Please update your emergency contact.
py: Qǐng gēng xīn jǐn jí lián xì rén.

en: Book the meeting room ahead of time.
py: Huì yì shì yào tí qián yù yuē.

en: The new colleague starts next Monday.
py: Xīn tóng shì xià zhōu yī rù zhí.

en: Tell your manager before you work overtime.
py: Jiā bān xiān gēn zhǔ guǎn shuō yì shēng.

en: Turn your medical report in to HR.
py: Tǐ jiǎn bào gào jiāo dào rén shì.

en: This notice is also on the bulletin board.
zh: 这条通知也贴在公告栏了。
py: Zhè tiáo tōng zhī yě tiē zài gōng gào lán le.

en: The last four digits of the part number are one zero four two.
zh: 料号末四位是幺零四二。
py: Liào hào mò sì wèi shì yāo líng sì èr.

en: Please make it to the latest drawing.
py: Qǐng àn zuì xīn bǎn tú zhǐ jiā gōng.

en: This drawing is revision three.
py: Zhè zhāng tú zhǐ shì dì sān bǎn.

en: This dimension is out of tolerance.
py: Zhè ge chǐ cùn chāo chā le.

en: The tolerance is plus or minus zero point one millimeters.
zh: 公差是正负零点一毫米。
py: Gōng chā shì zhèng fù líng diǎn yī háo mǐ.

en: Please inspect it to the national standard.
py: Qǐng àn guó biāo lái jiǎn yàn.

en: The drawing number is in the title block.
py: Tú hào xiě zài biāo tí lán lǐ.

en: Don't mix up the left-hand and right-hand parts.
py: Zuǒ yòu jiàn bú yào zhuāng fǎn.

en: Do the surface finish the way the drawing says.
zh: 表面处理按图纸要求做。
py: Biǎo miàn chǔ lǐ àn tú zhǐ yāo qiú zuò.

en: This standard part can be purchased outside.
py: Zhè ge biāo zhǔn jiàn kě yǐ wài gòu.

en: To the rider: Just leave it at the door.
py: Fàng mén kǒu jiù xíng.

en: To the rider: I'm home.
py: Wǒ zài jiā.

en: To the rider: Call me when you arrive.
py: Nǐ dào le gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà.

en: To the rider: Put it in front of the door.
py: Fàng zài mén qián miàn jiù xíng.

en: To the rider: No need to come up, thanks.
py: Bú yòng shàng lái, xiè xiè.

en: To the rider: The address is wrong.
py: Dì zhǐ xiě cuò le.

en: To the rider: Wait a minute.
py: Qǐng děng wǒ yí xià.

en: To the rider: I'll come down and get it.
py: Wǒ mǎ shàng xià lái ná.

en: To the rider: Just put it in the parcel locker.
py: Fàng kuài dì guì jiù xíng.

en: To the rider: Tell me when the food arrives.
py: Cān dào le gēn wǒ shuō yì shēng.

en: To the rider: I'll wait by the elevator.
py: Wǒ zài diàn tī kǒu děng nǐ.

en: To the rider: I sent you the gate code.
py: Mén jìn mì mǎ wǒ fā nǐ le.

en: To the rider: Don't knock. The baby is asleep.
py: Bié qiāo mén, hái zi zài shuì jiào.

en: To the rider: I'm in a meeting. Message me on WeChat.
py: Wǒ zài kāi huì, wēi xìn gēn wǒ shuō.

en: To the rider: Thanks. I appreciate it.
py: Xiè xiè, xīn kǔ le.

en: Rider says: Hello, your delivery is here.
py: Nín hǎo, wài mài dào le.

en: Rider says: I'm already downstairs.
py: Wǒ yǐ jīng dào lóu xià le.

en: Rider says: Can you come down and pick it up?
py: Nín fāng biàn xià lái qǔ yí xià ma?

en: Rider says: I left it at the door.
py: Wǒ fàng zài mén kǒu le.

en: Rider says: Please come out and get the food.
py: Qǐng nín chū lái qǔ cān.

en: Rider says: I can't get through the gate.
py: Mén jìn wǒ jìn bú qù.

en: Rider says: The address doesn't look right.
py: Dì zhǐ hǎo xiàng bú tài duì.

en: Rider says: I'm waiting downstairs.
py: Wǒ zài lóu xià děng nín.

en: Rider says: I left the food at the front desk.
py: Cān wǒ fàng qián tái le.

en: Rider says: I can't reach you.
py: Lián xì bú shàng nín.

en: Rider says: The elevator needs a card, so I can't come up.
py: Diàn tī yào shuā kǎ, wǒ shàng bú qù.

en: Rider says: Please change the delivery address.
py: Qǐng nín gǎi yí xià shōu huò dì zhǐ.

en: Rider says: The food is in the thermal bag. Please take it.
py: Cān zài bǎo wēn xiāng lǐ, qǐng ná hǎo.

en: Rider says: Please tell me the last digits of your phone.
py: Qǐng shuō yí xià shǒu jī wěi hào.

en: Rider says: Okay, I'll head off then.
py: Hǎo de, nà wǒ xiān zǒu le.

en: I called you.
py: Shī fu, wǒ dǎ nǐ diàn huà le.

en: I'm at the gate.
py: Wǒ zài dà mén kǒu.

en: I'm at the pickup point by the north exit.
py: Wǒ zài běi mén de shàng chē diǎn.

en: Please wait a moment.
py: Shī fu, děng wǒ yí xià.

en: To Lujiazui.
py: Qù lù jiā zuǐ.

en: Take the elevated road, not the highway.
py: Zǒu gāo jià, bié zǒu gāo sù.

en: Stop here and open the trunk.
zh: 师傅，这儿停，开一下后备箱。
py: Shī fu, zhèr tíng, kāi yí xià hòu bèi xiāng.

en: I've paid. Please confirm the order.
zh: 我付好了，订单确认一下。
py: Wǒ fù hǎo le, dìng dān què rèn yí xià.

en: That's the wrong car.
py: Shī fu, chē pái bú duì.

en: Thanks, driver.
py: Xiè xiè shī fu, xīn kǔ le.

en: We're going for morning tea (dim sum).
py: Wǒ men qù hē zǎo chá.

en: We need to queue and get a number.
py: Wǒ men xū yào pái duì qǔ hào.

en: Do you need to wait for a table?
py: Nín xū yào děng wèi ma?

en: I've already got a queue number.
py: Wǒ yǐ jīng qǔ hào le.

en: Waiter, please give me the menu.
py: Fú wù yuán, qǐng gěi wǒ cài dān.

en: We're going to order.
py: Wǒ men qù diǎn cān.

en: I have dietary restrictions.
py: Wǒ yǒu jì kǒu.

en: Please refill the tea.
py: Qǐng tiān chá.

en: Do we need to pack leftovers?
py: Wǒ men xū yào dǎ bāo ma?

en: Check please. How much is the tea cover charge?
py: Mǎi dān. Chá wèi fèi duō shǎo?

en: I want to shop online.
py: Wǒ xiǎng wǎng gòu.

en: I buy things on Taobao.
py: Wǒ zài táo bǎo shàng mǎi dōng xi.

en: I use my phone to search for products.
py: Wǒ yòng shǒu jī sōu suǒ shāng pǐn.

en: This product is relatively cheap.
py: Zhè ge shāng pǐn bǐ jiào pián yi.

en: Have you compared prices?
py: Nǐ bǐ jià le ma?

en: iPhones are more expensive than Huawei phones.
zh: 苹果手机比华为手机贵。
py: Píng guǒ shǒu jī bǐ huá wéi shǒu jī guì.

en: I have a coupon.
py: Wǒ yǒu yōu huì quàn.

en: Add to cart.
py: Fàng jìn gòu wù chē.

en: I got the parcel quickly.
py: Wǒ hěn kuài shōu dào le kuài dì.

en: I’m asking customer service to return it.
py: Wǒ zhǎo kè fú tuì huò.

en: I want to buy clothes.
py: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī fu.

en: What do you think of this hoodie?
zh: 你觉得这件卫衣怎么样？
py: Nǐ jué de zhè jiàn wèi yī zěn me yàng?

en: These sneakers are a little big.
py: Zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié yǒu diǎn er dà.

en: I want a medium.
py: Wǒ yào zhōng hào de.

en: Do you have it in black?
py: Yǒu hēi sè de ma?

en: Can I try it on?
py: Wǒ kě yǐ shì shi ma?

en: Please help me try on this skirt.
zh: 请帮我试一下这条裙子。
py: Qǐng bāng wǒ shì yí xià zhè tiáo qún zi.

en: This size is a little small.
py: Zhè ge chǐ mǎ yǒu diǎn er xiǎo.

en: Can the price be a bit cheaper?
zh: 价格可以便宜一点儿吗？
py: Jià gé kě yǐ pián yi yì diǎn er ma?

en: This item is on sale.
py: Zhè jiàn yī fu zài dǎ zhé.

en: I’m going to the supermarket to buy things.
py: Wǒ qù chāo shì mǎi dōng xi.

en: Excuse me, where is the entrance?
py: Qǐng wèn rù kǒu zài nǎ lǐ?

en: Where is the fruit and vegetable section?
py: Shuǐ guǒ shū cài qū zài nǎ lǐ?

en: I buy fish in the seafood section.
py: Wǒ zài hǎi xiān qū mǎi yú.

en: How do I get to the snack section?
py: Líng shí qū zěn me zǒu?

en: Please go straight, then turn right.
py: Qǐng zhí zǒu, rán hòu yòu zhuǎn.

en: Try it first, then buy it.
py: Xiān shì chī, zài mǎi dōng xi.

en: I’m going to the checkout to pay.
py: Wǒ qù shōu yín tái jié zhàng.

en: The exit is on the left.
py: Chū kǒu zài zuǒ biān.

en: Where do you go to buy fruit?
py: Nǐ qù nǎ lǐ mǎi shuǐ guǒ?
